verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents structured JSON parsing of Google Search and Google News results, a field-selection parameter, and positions its data for RAG pipelines. That implies per-result source metadata suitable for citation, but no evidence explicitly names URL, title, or published-date fields or describes their canonicalization. missing for 10: explicit documentation of link/title/date fields in result objects, assurance that URLs are canonical rather than redirect links, published-date coverage across engines, independent or hands-on corroboration.
